trial_court: Ms. Deepti Devesh, Ld. MM (Mahila Court− No.1), Shahdara, KKD Courts, Delhi, Crl. (A) No. 64/2019, New Crl. (A) No. 229/2019
case_name: Smt. Manisha Chawla vs Sh. Rahul Chawla (Husband)

parties.respondent_defendant: Sh. Rahul Chawla (husband), S/o. Sh. Rajesh Chawla, Father in-law, Smt. Sneha Chawla, W/o. Sh. Rajesh Chawla, Sh. Gaurav Chawla, S/o. Sh. Rajesh Chawla, Ms. Avneet Chawla, Sister in-law/Jethani, Ms. Richa Chawla, sister in-law/Nanad

facts_of_case: Appellant wife tried to find a suitable accommodation but could not succeed. She is entitled for same level of accommodation as enjoyed by respondents.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking condonation of delay to show sufficient cause for the delay.
legal_principles.held: I have considered the submissions made in application u/s. 5 of Limitation Act for condonation of delay of 7 days in filing the appeal and in view of reasons mentioned therein, the delay of 7 days in filing the appeal is condoned.

legal_principles.principle: The court may condone the delay in filing an appeal if sufficient cause is shown.
legal_principles.held: the delay of 7 days in filing the appeal is condoned.

outcome.final_order: Respondent no.1 was directed to pay a sum of Rs. 2,000/− per month to the complainant/appellant no.1 towards arrangement of alternative accommodation.

keywords: Protection of Women From Domestic Violence Act
